proposition: Qāsim-i Anvār was swept into the same 1427 action against suspected Hurufi sympathisers: MK's chapter 1 says he was arrested, the introduction says he was expelled from Herat, and a note says he was exiled from Herat in 1427 with Ibn Turka on suspect connections.

mediation.note: the three passages use different verbs (arrested, expelled, exiled) and MK does not reconcile them
